## Why visit

A June 2026 addition to the Piccadilly tasting cluster with an unusually broad advertised cask and keg choice for a new independent arch bar. It earns a specialist place for sheer beer-style breadth and an accessible stop near the station; food is available and the venue allows outside food. The attraction is discovery rather than traditional pub interiors, so keep it a flexible extra after the highest-priority Manchester pubs.

## Beer

Four changing cask and about twenty keg lines documented by CAMRA; actual beers rotate.

## Plan the visit

Closed Monday and Tuesday in the June/July 2026 entry. Wednesday first opens around 16:00, so it does not fit an early Stockport departure.

**Getting there:** Under Manchester Piccadilly station at Sheffield Street; near Balance and Sureshot.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
